name: Team Lease Services Ltd
about:
Team Lease Services provides employment related services. It provides solutions for staffing, recruitment, training, payroll processing and regulatory compliance.Its major business segments are:
- General staffing
- Specialized staffing
- HR Services
keyPoints:
Business Segments
The company is a leading player in the recruitment industry, offering a range of solutions: [1] 
1) General Staffing & Allied Services (93% in 9M FY25 vs 90% in FY22): [2] [3] The company offers staffing solutions, temporary recruitment and payroll & NETAP. The segment revenue grew by 22% YoY in 9M FY25, driven by a 16% rise in headcount. [4] [5]

cons: Stock is trading at 2.97 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -0.50%
Company has a low return on equity of 13.2% over last 3 years.
